text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle suffered a major injury, so 
she was treated in the nurse's office 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy and rest for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though I worked so hard on my 
training. When I think about how resting 
now will leave a gap in my progress..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... even just a light workout is fine. 
Just a little bit... please?
choice_data_list: You should get some rest for now.

If I judge that it's dangerous, I'll stop 
you immediately.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... even just a light workout is fine. 
Just a little bit... please?
choice_data_list: You should get some rest for now.

If I judge that it's dangerous, I'll stop 
you immediately.

text_block_list.text:
I explained that if the injury worsened, 
the recovery period would only get longer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That would... be even more troublesome. 
Then again, you do have a point...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to get plenty of rest so I 
can get back to training soon...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll proceed with care and 
caution.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. The pain might be getting 
stronger..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll pass after all. I did promise 
not to push myself, after all...

It seemed Hishi Miracle's injury had 
worsened... I immediately halted her 
training and had her rest.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If it's just this much, it should be 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep this pace up while making sure 
to stay careful.

Hishi Miracle continued with light 
training after that, and managed to make a 
smooth recovery.
